summary: Lazard, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) on November 6, 2026, disclosing a Rule 424(b) prospectus supplement covering the possible resale of up to 9,416,817 common shares issued to selling stockholders as consideration in its previously announced acquisition of 100% of Campbell Lutyens Holdings Limited. The filing attaches a Sullivan & Cromwell validity opinion (Exhibit 5.1) confirming the shares are validly issued, fully paid and nonassessable. No new stake, price, premium or closing terms are stated. This is a routine resale-registration mechanics update; watch the overhang from potential selling-stockholder sales.
